verdict: Johnson & Johnson's sales rose 6% to $25.4B, but a one-time charge for the proposed talc litigation settlement crushed reported profit to $210M — $0.09 a share. Excluding special items it earned $6.34B, or $2.59 a share, and raised its full-year guidance.

kpis.label: Adjusted EPS
kpis.note: excludes special charges and deal costs

kpis.label: FY26 guidance
kpis.note: sales ~$101.2B and adjusted EPS $11.10 at the midpoint

segments.name: Innovative Medicine
segments.note: Prescription drugs — cancer, immunology and neuroscience medicines led 7.7% growth, with U.S. sales up 11.1%.

segments.name: MedTech
segments.note: Medical devices — surgery, orthopaedics, vision and cardiovascular tools; the quarter brought market authorization for OTTAVA, its soft-tissue surgical robot.

opex.name: Selling, marketing and administrative
opex.note: The global sales force and back office behind both drugs and devices.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Drug trials and device development — up 27% year over year, including acquired research programs.

opex.name: Impairments & restructuring
opex.note: $339M of in-process R&D impairments — writing down acquired research projects that are no longer expected to pay off — plus $181M of supply-chain and franchise restructuring costs.

otherDetail: Other expense of $5,780M — dominated by a one-time special charge for the proposed talc litigation resolution, plus costs of the Firefly Bio acquisition and the Sail Biomedicines collaboration — together with $31M of net interest expense.

takeaways.title: One charge, two stories
takeaways.text: GAAP EPS was $0.09 after the talc settlement charge and deal costs; adjusted EPS of $2.59 shows the underlying quarter. Reported net earnings fell 96% to $210M from $5.15B.

takeaways.title: The business underneath is accelerating
takeaways.text: Operational sales grew 6.0% — Innovative Medicine +7.9% operationally — and management now targets double-digit growth by the end of the decade.

takeaways.title: Guidance raised
takeaways.text: J&J lifted its 2026 outlook to about $101.2B of sales (+7.4% at the midpoint) and adjusted EPS of $11.10.

oneTimers: A one-time special charge for the proposed talc litigation resolution sits inside the $5,780M of other expense, alongside Firefly Bio acquisition and Sail Biomedicines collaboration costs. Adjusted net earnings of $6,339M exclude these items.
footerNote: Tax was a $176M benefit this quarter (the talc charge cut pre-tax income to just $34M), so the chart shows it flowing into the bottom line rather than out of it.
